fragments.text: Who should come: This is a builders-only AI Tinkerers event, and attendance is by application only. It is for engineers, technical founders, researchers, and designers who build and are ready to spend the day shipping a working prototype.

Global Sponsors: OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company whose mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Its work spans frontier research and products that turn advanced AI capabilities into tools people and organizations can use. OpenAI is focused on making advanced intelligence safe, useful, accessible, and broadly beneficial—supporting greater productivity, creativity, scientific progress, and economic opportunity. CopilotKit CopilotKit is the Agentic Application Platform, an open-source framework and cloud platform for building and operating production-grade agentic applications. Its stack connects AI agents to user-facing products through in-app actions, generative UI, real-time context awareness, and support for protocols including AG-UI, MCP, and A2A. OpenRouter OpenRouter is an AI gateway and model marketplace offering a unified interface for hundreds of models across multiple providers. It is designed to reduce vendor lock-in while improving availability, pricing flexibility, and control over model routing. Many more global partners will be joining the event and added to this page soon.

fragments.text: Developer Infrastructure Partners: Exa Exa builds search infrastructure for AI applications. Its search engine and APIs help developers and agents find, retrieve, and synthesize high-quality web content through natural-language queries. Trigger.dev Trigger.dev is an open-source background jobs framework for building reliable workflows in plain async code. It provides infrastructure for long-running tasks and AI workloads, including queuing, retries, elastic scaling, and real-time monitoring. Auth0 Auth0 is an identity platform for developers, providing authentication and authorization infrastructure for web, mobile, and AI applications. Its SDKs and APIs help teams add secure login, access control, and identity workflows without building them from scratch. Mozilla Mozilla.ai builds open-source AI tools and infrastructure designed to make it easier for developers to create trustworthy, transparent, and controllable AI applications. Ambiguous AI Ambiguous is the workspace for human-AI collaboration. 17 productivity apps rebuilt from scratch to make work flow across Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, Calendar, and more. Each AI coworker has its own identity and works in the same apps and on the same data like the rest of the team. You can send it an email, message it in chat, assign it a task, or @mention it in a comment. Teams of up to five can use all 17 apps for free, and agents can get started through CLI or MCP in under a minute. sourceEvidence.title: Inside RAISE Summit 2025: Bringing AI Infrastructure to Center Stage | Vultr Blogs

fragments.text: Last week, Vultr participated in the 2025 RAISE Summit, an extraordinary gathering of global AI leaders hosted in the heart of Paris. Set beneath the glass pyramid of the Carrousel du Louvre, the summit was a celebration of innovation, policy, and real-world AI impact. For Vultr, the location was especially meaningful: Paris is not only home to one of our 32 cloud data center regions, but also a key market where data sovereignty, compliance, and cloud independence matter deeply.

One of the most exciting parts of the week was sponsoring the agentic AI hackathon, organized by our partner lablab.ai. With over 100 participating teams and more than 50 Vultr-powered submissions, our track was the most popular of the summit. The engagement, creativity, and engineering talent on display were exceptional.

The Agent Arena Hackathon: Note: This event is fully in-person in San Francisco. Teams may have up to four members. All attendees must apply and be approved. Submitting an application does not guarantee a seat; approved applicants must confirm their attendance.
San Francisco, CASep 26 at 9:00 AM – Sep 27 at 5:00 PM (PDT)
Join us at The Agent Arena Hackathon hosted by Vultr to build what the next generation of agent infrastructure actually looks like in production.

Vultr is bringing the tools for you to build infrastructure powering the next generation of autonomous execution: VM backends, serverless inference, and the compute layer agents run on when they stop talking and start acting.
